_comment: Removable inbox apps (allowlist). Only these are offered. guard: xbox = blocked while Xbox or Game Pass games are installed; xboxOrX3d = also on dual-CCD X3D CPUs. reinstall: store = still listed in the Microsoft Store (storeId = Store product id, checked with the Store catalog API, market US, 2026-10-10); none = Microsoft no longer offers it there or the listing is not confirmed. protected: names never offered; * matches a prefix; !name is an exception to a prefix (Edge Game Assist under Microsoft.Edge*). unreviewedExcluded: never offered among the apps that were not reviewed either (parts of Windows, language and handwriting packs, video and audio codecs, what games and the Store sign-in need); protected and non-removable packages are left out as well.
